# DharmaNexus annotations (`dharmanexus_annotations.csv`)

Bibliographic and content notes for texts in this corpus, from the provenance
pass over the DharmaNexus Sanskrit catalog (dharmamitra.org, October 2026).

**These notes were generated by LLMs. Please double-check them before citing.**
Every entry was drafted by Gemini 3.8 Flash from the e-text, its source
headers, OCR'd reference literature and INBUDS. About a fifth of the entries
were hard cases (unclear edition, partial coverage, several works in one file)
and were re-checked by Claude Opus; the `reviewed` column says which.

All entries were then fact-checked claim by claim against local evidence only
(no web search): the source headers (GRETIL, this repository's TEI headers and
catalogue records, the DSBC book pages), samples of the e-text, the Tibetan
canon catalogue (Derge numbers, translators from the colophons), the Chinese
canon catalogue (CBETA), INBUDS and OCR'd secondary literature. Claims the
evidence contradicted were corrected; claims it did not support were removed,
as were page ranges, volume/series numbers and years not found in the
evidence. Some correct facts were removed this way because no local source
holds them, so an empty field means "not verified", not "does not exist".

## Keys

`collection` + `file` match the `file` column of `metadata/<collection>.csv`;
for Wikisource, `sub_folder` + `file` match `wikisource.csv`. A corpus file can
have more than one row when DharmaNexus splits it into several texts.

`link` says how the corpus file was matched to the DharmaNexus text:

- `imported`: DharmaNexus imported the text from this repository (commit 222bcc4).
- `text overlap`: DharmaNexus already had the text from elsewhere (GRETIL,
  DSBC, Muktabodha, ...). The DharmaNexus text covers at least 80% of the
  corpus file (`overlap`, by shingles) and the two have similar length.

## Columns

| column | content |
|---|---|
| `dharmanexus_id`, `dharmanexus_url` | the DharmaNexus text |
| `dharmanexus_title`, `dharmanexus_author` | normalised title and author as now used in DharmaNexus |
| `also_known_as` | other titles |
| `coverage`, `coverage_note` | complete / partial / fragment / excerpt / unclear, with the extent |
| `included_works` | when a file contains several works (root text + commentary, ...) |
| `attribution_note` | notes on authorship |
| `edition_used_status`, `edition_used` | printed edition the e-text derives from: determined / probable / not determined |
| `etext` | who produced the e-text |
| `edition_evidence` | why the edition was identified (headers, page markers, catalogue entries, ...) |
| `other_editions`, `translations` | further editions and translations (Tibetan translations with translators as given in the Derge colophons) |
| `versions_tibetan`, `versions_chinese`, `versions_english` | DharmaNexus ids of the Tibetan (Derge), Chinese (Taishō) and English versions of the text; open as `https://dharmamitra.org/nexus/db/<bo,zh,en>/<id>/text` |
| `date_median`, `date_95` | date estimate of the DharmaNexus Sanskrit dating model ([chronology](https://dharmamitra.github.io/sanskrit-dating/sanskrit_chronology_interactive.html)): posterior median and 95% credible interval |
| `summary` | short content summary |
| `confidence` | high / medium / low |
| `reviewed` | Gemini only, or Gemini + Claude review; "fact-checked" after the check against local evidence |

Multiple values within a cell are separated by ` | `.
